summary: GlobalFoundries filed a 6-K furnishing an October 14, 2026 press release announcing its selection as technology provider and operator of two new 300mm semiconductor fabs at its Malta, New York site under a U.S.-Japan initiative. Japan funds up to $21 billion—approximately $10 billion for a first fab targeted to come online in 2029, and roughly $10 billion potentially for a second. Separately, the U.S. Department of Commerce receives equity of approximately four percent in GF, and GF's existing CHIPS award is amended to reallocate $955 million toward silicon photonics, SiGe and advanced packaging. No per-share price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is disclosed. Key watch items: dilution from the government's equity stake, funding timing, and execution of the 2029 fab timeline.
